title: Joe Williams, Basie and the false stage entrance
summary: A story told by Freddie Green and Thad Jones about Joe Williams ignoring Basie's quiet advice and stepping on stage lights.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Uh-huh. You told me a story last night, I think at dinner, about Joe Williams and Count Basie.
Oh, I don't know whether I should tell it.
I think that's funny. I think you ought to tell that story.

Well, I think they were in -- I heard from Freddie Greene and Thad Jones, so it must be in order. They were in London, I believe. You know, there are some theaters that have false entrances, you know. As you go on stage, you know.
One entrance is a false entrance and the other side is the one you're supposed to come on and go off, you know?
And Joe saw a lady he liked and he kept talking to her. And Count Basie doesn't talk loud, you know.

He just walked past Joe and said, 'Joe, don't go in on this side. Go around to the other side.' And Joe didn't seem like he paid him much -- excuse me -- paid him much attention. So Basie started -- he just counted off 'Every Ray,' and that woke Joe up, you know. He stopped talking to the young lady, you know. So when Joe went into this false entrance, there were nothing but stage lights under his feet, and it sounded like gunshots, pow, pow. He's trying to get to the microphone, and the guys in the band, they broke up laughing, because they saw him -- he was stumbling, you know, because the light bulbs were breaking up under his feet. He couldn't hardly walk, you know. And he got there, but this -- I'm trying to describe it as it was described to me. But I can see it, where it would crack somebody up. And Basie was slick. He kept telling Joe to go around the other side, and Joe wasn't paying any attention.
Always give the leader your full attention, right?
Yeah. But see, Basie, he doesn't go around with a whip. He says it very quietly, you know.

And Joe was so intent on dating this chick, that's what was wrong with him. He wasn't paying attention. So just like the old saying, to get a mule's attention you've got to hit him in the head with a two by four. So that's what Basie did to Joe. Yeah, that's a funny story.
